heroTitle: Smart POS & Inventory for Sari-Sari Stores
heroSubtitle: Track sales, manage utang credit ledgers, and scan shelf barcodes in real-time. Built specifically for Philippine neighborhood retail stores.
featurePosDesc: Ring up sales in seconds with webcam scanning, USB barcode readers, or your smartphone paired over Wi-Fi.
featureUtangDesc: Never lose a single peso. Keep automated credit ledgers for suki customers with customizable credit limits.
featureInventoryDesc: Automated low stock warnings and restock recommendations so your shelves never run out of best sellers.
featureOfflineDesc: Works smoothly even on unstable network connections. Bilingual English and Taglish interface.
footerTagline: Made with passion for Philippine sari-sari store owners.
